[1/4] Plan: v0.21 world graphics pass - per-map ground decor, layered trees, shaded rocks and lit building windows, fading scorch decals, player rim/overdrive and boss ground auras

impact_assessment.why: After v0.20 the atmosphere and combat feedback read well, but screenshots still showed empty ground between props, flat trees and rocks, unlit window holes, explosions that vanished without a trace, and weak player/boss presence against the terrain
impact_assessment.benefits: Each map gets a distinct ground-detail identity, props gain depth and inhabited details, explosions leave spatial history, and the player and bosses read more clearly without changing gameplay
impact_assessment.risks: contract: render helpers gain non-solid decor and decal state, snapshot gains a read-only decals count, no save schema or mechanics change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: decals capped and transient
impact_assessment.mitigation: Place decor by hash so the seeded gameplay stream is unchanged, keep decor non-solid, cap and fade decals, test per-map decor kinds and decal lifecycle, rerun the full suite and draw budgets, capture fresh screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

impact_assessment.why: The v0.22 task marked complete while its test file had been replaced by 50 lines, so 118 regression tests vanished; the uncommitted game.js also changed skill caps, the XP curve and frame hit-stop, and added six untested systems, leaving the project unable to detect regressions
impact_assessment.benefits: The full regression shield is back and extended to 130 tests, every v0.22 system has evidence, and README/package describe the shipped 0.22.0 feature set
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests and docs only, plus no gameplay edits; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Restore tests from HEAD instead of rewriting them, adapt only the intended mechanics, add focused seams-based tests, and gate with node --test tests plus python aikit.py check dustline

[1/4] Plan: playtest feedback pass - total-kill milestone callouts (10/25/50/100/250/500), a score system, LAST STAND under 10% HP, kill-streak rewards (supply, airstrike, helicopter, missile barrage), per-run mutations, secret combos, war chests gated by kills, a slower XP curve and map camouflage

impact_assessment.why: Playtesters asked for stronger dopamine feedback, a score, low-health risk, hidden unlocks and slower leveling; the current build announces only every tenth streak kill and has no total-kill milestones, score, mutations or kill-gated chests
impact_assessment.benefits: Each run now has escalating callouts and rewards, visible score progression, a high-risk LAST STAND, mutation-driven replayability, community-discoverable secret combos and map-specific camouflage, while level-ups slow to a readable pace
impact_assessment.risks: contract: run state, save schema, HUD and setup gains fields, combat multipliers change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: save migration must default new score/secret fields
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep every new family capped and seeded, extend snapshot/seams for tests, migrate saves with defaults, update the full suite, run all gates, and capture screenshots for the new overlays
